tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Initial curvature lies in the pinching region] ↗ claim:pinching-region-convex

${\mathcal T}(x,0)\in Z(x,0)$ for all $x\in M$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch The initial lower bound $\lambda +\mu +\nu \ge -3$ gives $S\ge -3$. If $0<X(x,0)\le 1$, then $S\ge -3X\ge X(\log X-3)$.

□
